entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to talk about a return for a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought recently. I think I might be just outside the return period, but there were some extenuating circumstances.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It works fine, it's a preference thing. Honestly, my situation changed right after I bought it. I had a sudden medical emergency and ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. I just haven't been able to use it, and now I won't be able to for a while.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well. Can you confirm the date you received the device?

Let's see... it was delivered 19 days ago. I know that's probably past the standard time, but on top of my medical issue, my spouse just got notice of a last-minute deployment, so things have been chaotic. I was hoping we could work something out, maybe a partial credit?
I understand completely. Thank you for explaining. Let me just pull up our return policy here... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. It looks like you received the item 19 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, 90 days? Oh, I thought it was much shorter for these kinds of devices. Are you sure?
Yes, I'm looking right at your account and our policy information. You are well within the window. No need for any special exceptions.
Wow, that's fantastic news! I completely misunderstood. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it within the next 5-10 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives at our warehouse.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah. You've made my day a lot easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you a speedy recovery.
